The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `6333` (see `QdrantBuilder.QdrantHttpPort`)
- Port: `6334` (see `QdrantBuilder.QdrantGrpcPort`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /readyz` is completed successfully.
